officialRevision: Firebase Authentication: Control access with custom claims; Identity Platform multi-factor authentication (TOTP)

limits.officialText: The custom claims payload must not exceed 1000 bytes
limits.notes: Measured on canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) UTF-8 bytes.

limits.officialText: A user can enroll one TOTP second factor
limits.notes: Official wording to be confirmed against Identity Platform; enforced locally at 1.

limits.officialText: Firebase ID tokens expire one hour after they are issued
limits.notes: exp = iat + 3600 on the virtual clock.

limits.officialText: TOTP enrollment sessions expire; the exact backend lifetime is not published
limits.notes: Local versioned policy default 300 s; never used as a production-compatible hard error.
